findings.evidence: French physical248 labels both X->Y and X->Z arrows f; Chinese labels X->Z h.
findings.recommendation: Keep mathematically coherent h if desired only with concise visible translator note explicitly stating French has f; user requires original errors retained, so preferably original f in diagram plus note identifying h.
findings.mathematical_assessment: h is clearly intended by text and composition; this is an original diagram-label typo.

findings.evidence: Both French physical249 and Chinese start by assuming f_*(E) a-pseudo-coherent and conclude f_*(E) a-pseudo-coherent, although theorem assumes h-relative pseudo-coherence.
findings.recommendation: Preserve body and add visible 译校注 that first f_* should be h_* (or g_*f_*) for the proof's intended reduction.
findings.mathematical_assessment: Original repeated-f typo creates tautological opening; subsequent induction uses g_*(E) as expected.

findings.evidence: French physical253 says E-prime is a degres bornes; Chinese says E-prime 上有界.
findings.recommendation: Change 上有界 to 有界 here; E-prime is finite truncation from t to a, and a single N for all components uses finite many terms.
findings.mathematical_assessment: Context already establishes boundedness, but translation weakens explicit original premise.

findings.evidence: French physical254 says acyclique en degre >=a in proof although statement says >a; Chinese retains >=a.
findings.recommendation: Preserve original >=a and add visible note explaining theorem statement uses >a; no silent correction.
findings.mathematical_assessment: Proof can use >a and theorem2.2.2; original >=a unnecessarily strengthens the reduction.

findings.evidence: French physical255 proof cites (2.2),(2.5),(1.12), including itself; Chinese preserves self-citation2.5.
findings.recommendation: Add concise visible translator note that original self-citation2.5 is retained, likely2.4 intended.
findings.mathematical_assessment: 2.4 supplies boundedness result; 2.2 and1.12 supply pseudo-coherence.

findings.evidence: Both original physical258 and Chinese identify O_{X,x} with A1 tensor_C A2 and O_{Y,y} with B1 tensor_C B2 without localization.
findings.recommendation: Retain source identities and add concise visible note that these tensor products generally require localization at the selected product point, or that the subsequent affine argument must interpret A/B as affine coordinate rings.
findings.mathematical_assessment: Stalk of fiber product is a localization of tensor products of stalks, not generally the raw tensor product. Faithfulness and proof validity are distinct.

findings.target: Proposition3.7 statement following M in Db(S)_qcoh
findings.evidence: Original physical261 footnote2 explicitly explains qcoh denotes the full subcategory of complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology. Chinese statement has only footnote1([H]II5.6).
findings.recommendation: Restore the original qcoh footnote at M in Db(S)_qcoh, even though similar notation was defined earlier.

findings.target: Proposition3.7 proof opening finite amplitude assumption
findings.evidence: Statement requires E finite flat amplitude relative to S; French physical262 proof says relative to f. Chinese faithfully repeats relative to f.
findings.recommendation: Preserve f in body and add visible translator note that theorem hypothesis is relative to S; the first-case resolution argument requires S-relative amplitude.
findings.mathematical_assessment: These conditions differ; original proof slips from S to f.

findings.target: Proposition4.6 proof after truncation arrow t
findings.evidence: French physical269 and Chinese say E is acyclic outside[a,b] near s, although E is on X and the proof is local near x.
findings.recommendation: Preserve original s and add short translator note that x is intended.
findings.mathematical_assessment: This is a point-name slip; hypothesis(i) is local on X near x.

findings.evidence: French physical271 and Chinese cite hypotheses(4.6), but introduce f1,f2 and their product from4.7.
findings.recommendation: Retain(4.6) and add visible note that relevant hypotheses are in4.7.
findings.mathematical_assessment: Original reference mismatch, not a new hypothesis.

findings.target: Corollary4.9.1 opening and Corollary4.9.2 first proof sentence
findings.evidence: Both passages in French physical273 and Chinese cite4.8;4.9.1 is deduced by taking E=OX in4.9, and4.9.2 says apply4.8 with Y=S,F=OS although4.8 has no F.
findings.recommendation: Retain both original4.8 citations with concise visible notes that4.9 is intended.
findings.mathematical_assessment: Duality assertions use4.9;4.8 is direct-image finiteness.

findings.evidence: French physical272–277 explicitly underlines Hom,Ext and derived Hom when they are sheaf-valued. Chinese uses Hom/RHom/Ext macros without underlines; preamble Hom=operatorname{Hom}, chapter RHom=R operatorname{Hom},Ext=operatorname{Ext}.
findings.recommendation: Restore native underlined operator notation locally, e.g. underline{operatorname{Hom}},underline{operatorname{Ext}},R underline{operatorname{Hom}} at original sheaf-valued occurrences. Do not globally change ordinary/global Hom elsewhere.
findings.mathematical_assessment: 5.1 functors take Mod(X) to Mod(X), so target Hom must be an internal Hom sheaf; ordinary global Hom is not an object of Mod(X). Similar issue affects the derived dual E-vee.

findings.evidence: French physical280: complexe a degres bornes de OX-Modules quasi-coherents plats et de presentation finie rel.a f; it invokes4.3.2. Chinese says 拟凝聚平坦 OX-模的有界复形,且各项关于f有限表现, attaching relative qualification only to finite presentation.
findings.recommendation: Translate unambiguously as 各项拟凝聚、关于f平坦且有限表现的OX-模有界复形.
findings.mathematical_assessment: 4.3.2 requires f-flatness. Absolute OX-flatness plus relative finite presentation does not imply f-finite Tor amplitude; OX itself over a nonperfect finitely presented morphism is a counterexample to that reading.

review_method: All52 controlling French pages rendered as full-page pairs and visually compared to Chinese TeX. Small exponents on254/256/257 and273 formula additionally inspected in enlarged original crops. No OCR-only page credited.
